'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an instructor who can be found teaching a class of Rabelle College students at the [[Synth Armament Crafting Bay]] in Startorch Academy.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Dagdir''' Treat the Mechascout as an extension of your own body and senses...
:;'''Dagdir''' Remember that feeling... Reach the pinnacle of human–machine unity...
:At the Division of Tactical Development's proving grounds, an instructor is giving a public lecture......
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen.)
::'''Dagdir:''' I'm the instructor for this open "Mechascout Operations Practice" class. I'm also a grad from the Rabelle College, Class of '04. I'm your senior, but there's no need for formality. You can just call me "Old Dag."
::'''Dagdir:''' Since this is a practical class, just talking theory clearly won't cut it for you all... So, who wants to be the first to try hands-on operation?
::'''Hiroyuki:''' Me!!
::'''Dagdir:''' Huh? Speak up if you wanna pilot a Mechascout! AGAIN!!!
::'''Hiroyuki:''' ME!!!!!!!!!!!!
::'''Dagdir:''' Good! That's the spirit! Now, link your Stargram to the port on top of the Mechascout's head. That'll give you temporary control.
::'''Hiroyuki:''' Sir, why did it just... trigger an orange alert?
::'''Dagdir:''' The light strip on the Mechascout's face shows real-time Void Storm density and the operator's own frequency stability.
::'''Dagdir:''' For a freshman operating a Mechascout for the first time, getting worked up is completely normal. Take a deep breath. Calm yourself down.
::'''Dagdir:''' Once the link is established, the Mechascout will respond and move in line with our every thought.
::'''Dagdir:''' Only by treating the Mechascout as an extension of your own body and senses will you reach the pinnacle of human–machine unity...
::'''Dagdir:''' Remember that feeling. If one day you make it through all the trials and finally take command of the Exostrider… this experience will be a huge help.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Leave.)
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;'''Dagdir''' Chin up! Chest out! Where's your fire?!
:;'''Dagdir''' You're a Synchronist, aren't you? What's with this sniveling?
:;'''Hiroyuki''' B-but what's going to happen to Rabelle College...
:In the Tactical Proving Grounds, an instructor is giving a dejected student a brutal dressing-down.
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Listen)
::'''Dagdir:''' Answer me, Hiroyuki! Who are you? What are you doing here? Why did you come to this place?
::'''Hiroyuki:''' I... I'm Hiroyuki! A first-year at Rabelle College! I came here to learn! To gain skill! To make my ideals real!
::'''Dagdir:''' Good energy! Wrong answer!
::'''Dagdir:''' Burn this into your skull! You are a SYNCHRONIST of Rabelle College, Startorch Academy!
::'''Dagdir:''' No matter where you go, no matter what happens! Even if the Exostrider leaves, even if the Synchronist program changes. YOU. ARE. STILL. A. SYNCRHONIST!
::'''Hiroyuki:''' But Dag... wasn't the Synchronist Development Program created so we could pilot the Exostrider...?
::'''Dagdir:''' Answer me this, Hiroyuki. Have you ever stopped to ask why both the Exostrider and the Mechascouts are humanoid?
::'''Hiroyuki:''' Because... frequency control is easier that way? Let's us adapt to combat more naturally?
::'''Dagdir:''' Wrong! With a Synchronist's abilities, you really think you couldn't pilot a quadruped robot? Or a dreadnought gun?
::'''Dagdir:''' The Exostrider is humanoid because it carries the human spirit! Its creator meant for it to stand. On this earth. As we do. Forever.
::'''Dagdir:''' The moment you get used to sitting behind heavy artillery, pouring fire from a safe distance, you stop being a person. You become a weapon. And a weapon doesn't search for a way forward.
::'''Dagdir:''' The Exostrider's limbs. Its armament. Each one is a symbol of humankind. An extension of the human spirit!
::'''Dagdir:''' So when you inherit that spirit as a Synchronist, what difference does it make whether the Exostrider is here or not?!
{{Dialogue End}}
